notes: Keep this feature backend-only. The canvas graph remains user-authored and the web UI is not changed.
Provider-specific HTTP, credentials, and model payload logic remain in the Model Gateway boundary rather than moving into agent-runtime.
Current process-local storage remains an explicitly non-durable MVP boundary; this task defines a replaceable memory reader contract without claiming PostgreSQL memory exists.

small_features.title: Organize current node execution behind Agent Runtime
scope: Create a backend xmeta_api/agent_runtime module with explicit contracts, task profile registry, memory reader boundary, prompt compilation, and typed node handlers.
Register the currently implemented text, image, audio, and video tasks without changing their public FastAPI request or response contracts.
Move Script prompt and execution ownership into agent-runtime while retaining thin compatibility imports if existing callers rely on the old modules.
Route current FastAPI generation endpoints through agent-runtime handlers while leaving provider-specific implementation in xmeta_api/providers.py.
Add focused backend tests for profile lookup, memory selection, prompt compilation, and preserved route behavior.
Document the Agent Runtime and Model Gateway boundary in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
verification: Run focused Agent Runtime pytest coverage.
Run the full services/api pytest suite and Ruff checks.
Run the existing web test suite to prove public contracts and the canvas remain unaffected.
Run JSON validation, git diff --check, and final .\init.ps1.
evidence: Added services/api/xmeta_api/agent_runtime with contracts, seven current task profiles, registry, scoped memory reader, prompt compiler, bounded retry, validators, and typed text/image/audio/video handlers.
Existing Script prompt and runner modules now provide compatibility exports while FastAPI routes delegate current node execution to agent_runtime.
Provider-specific HTTP payloads, credentials, supported models, and provider retry behavior remain in xmeta_api/providers.py and were not changed.
Focused Agent Runtime pytest passed 15 tests; full API pytest passed 70 tests; Ruff passed; full web tests passed 9 files / 58 tests.
Live local Uvicorn smoke returned OpenAPI 200 with 8 paths and an expected truthful missing-provider-config 503; no external provider credential or live generation was used.
JSON validation, full git diff --check, and final .\init.ps1 passed.
